findings.summary: A failed re-review supersedes a completed blocking review but is excluded from the open-finding guard, allowing a fresh passing fallback to make CI pass while the inherited blocking finding remains unresolved.

The runner never writes a conformance block or accepts the covered tasks and deviations, so every conformance record it generates fails the new evidence check and specced PRs cannot pass through the documented workflow.
The scanner ignores Semgrep's errors array, so an exit-0 response containing parse or partial-scan errors and no results is reported as a clean scan even when code blocks could not be checked.
